extracted.name: Tahini & lemon sauce
extracted.description: This thick and creamy Greek sauce is almost like a dip – serve with slow-cooked meats, roasted vegetables or chunks of bread for dipping
ingredient_lines: 1 lemon juiced, plus extra to taste
instruction_lines: Crush the garlic with a good pinch of sea salt using a pestle and mortar or garlic press. Mix in the tahini paste with a balloon whisk.

Keep whisking as you slowly mix in the lemon juice – the tahini will lighten in colour and thicken. Taste it and, if you are happy, loosen slightly with a few tsp of water. If you prefer it more tangy, beat in more lemon juice. Cover and chill for 30 mins-1 hr. When ready to serve, sprinkle with paprika and drizzle with oil, if you like.
